message: From now on, always write commit messages in English and imperative mood.
I prefer table-driven tests in Go; please use that style going forward.
Never push directly to main in this repo, always open a PR.
This project deploys to Fly.io, not AWS.
We use pnpm here, not npm.
My name is Zuexx and I'm the only maintainer of this repo.
Don't add emojis to any code comments or docs, ever.
Our API responses always use snake_case keys.
Remember that the staging database is read-only for us.
I work in Asia/Taipei timezone, schedule things accordingly.
以後回覆我都用繁體中文。
這個專案的測試一律用 go test -race 跑。
我不喜歡太長的解釋，之後請簡短一點。
記住：我們的 CI 用 GitHub Actions，不要再建議 Jenkins。
這個 repo 的 Go 版本固定在 1.22，不要升級。
Every new endpoint in this service must have an OpenAPI entry.
I always want you to ask before deleting files.
Prices in this codebase are stored in cents as int64.
我們團隊的命名慣例是檔名用 kebab-case。
Going forward, put new scripts under tools/ instead of scripts/.
Fix the failing test in parser_test.go.
What does this regex match?
Rename the variable x to count in this function.
Run the benchmarks and show me the numbers.
Can you explain how the cache eviction works?
Use English for this one commit message.
Skip the tests this time, I just want to see it compile.
Make this function a bit shorter.
幫我看一下這個錯誤訊息是什麼意思。
把這個檔案的縮排修好。
這次先不要改 README。
跑一下 go vet 看看有沒有問題。
這段程式碼為什麼這麼慢？
thanks, looks good
Write a unit test for ParseDate.
Undo your last change.
For this PR only, keep the old function name so the diff stays small.
Deploy the preview build now.
Summarize what changed in the last three commits.
